title: Language Modeling: interactive simulations and code
description:
Interactive simulations and short, runnable code on how language models work.

First piece: Training a Transformer, a step-by-step simulation of one training run of a tiny GPT (tokenizer, embeddings, attention, MLP, loss, backpropagation, updates, sampling), with tiny_gpt.py, the 300-line PyTorch script behind every number. Online: https://alirezabayatmk.github.io/language-modeling/

Content: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Code: MIT. The model and training loop are adapted from nanoGPT by Andrej Karpathy (MIT).
